data.one_liner: A Flutter component library offering pre-built UI widgets and responsive designs.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of ready‑to‑use UI components such as buttons, cards, lists, dialogs, and platform‑aware widgets. Includes customization options and built‑in responsiveness for mobile, web, and desktop.
use_when: You need a quick set of customizable UI widgets without building them from scratch
Your app targets multiple platforms and requires responsive components
You want a consistent look and feel across Android, iOS, web, and desktop
avoid_when: You need advanced animation features (requires a separate package)
Your project relies heavily on state‑management or backend services
You prefer a full UI kit that follows Material or Cupertino design strictly
strengths: Built‑in platform awareness and responsive sizing
Easy to integrate with a single dependency
weaknesses: Animation support is split into another package
Limited to UI components—no state‑management or networking features
Documentation may be less extensive than core Flutter widgets
data.setup_notes: Add widgets_easier to pubspec; add flutter_easy_animations separately for animation features

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a comprehensive set of Material‑styled widgets with similar ease of use

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers Cupertino‑styled widgets for iOS‑look‑and‑feel apps
